messages:
maria: Handoff for this weekend — I'm oncall until Sat 09:00 UTC. Leaving VIP coverage for CobaltRetail (contract SLA: 99.95%). Scheduled load test Sat 03:00 UTC: steady 500 RPS, bursts to 1k for 5m. Main risk: infra deploy M-42 at 02:30 UTC that touches routing. Please watch runbook + rollout dashboard: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/cobalt-loadtest

jonathan: Thanks — I can cover starting 09:00 UTC. Quick Q: is the burst_policy already disabled for Cobalt? Last week we saw slow GPU warmup during auto-scale.

maria: Good call. I added a temporary bypass for burst_policy on the cobalt tenant and scheduled a flag rollout at 01:45 UTC. It's at 1% canary now. If error budget burn >0.5% in a 15m window, flip the flag to 0% and notify infra.

liam: I'll be up for the early window. Oncall checklist reminders: monitor queue depth, KV cache hit rate, and model fallback readiness.

liam: Checkpoints/commands if you're looking at metrics:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://metrics.internal/api/tenants/cobaltretail?range=15m | jq '.'
kubectl -n prod get hpa cobalt-inference -o wide
```

oncall-bot: Reminder — scheduled maintenance window 02:00-02:45 UTC for infra deploy M-42. If rollback occurs, page SRE rotation.

alex: FYI, contract SLA requires a 15-min customer notification if expected downtime >0.5%. I've prepped a one-line customer note template in #support-desk. @maria can you approve?

maria: Approved. Template is short: "We're running an engineering load test that may affect latency briefly; we'll follow up if we observe any customer impact." Also pinned alert thresholds: error_rate >0.5% for 15m and p95 latency >600ms for 10m.

jonathan: I'll be first responder. If we need to spin a fallback, use model alias `cobalt_v1_fallback` — it's preloaded on the dedicated pool and has lower throughput but is stable.

liam: If autoscale doesn't keep up, manual scale command: `kubectl scale --replicas=6 deploy/cobalt-route` — that'll buy time while we warm nodes.

maria: Leaving contact list in the oncall doc: infra oncall @sre-infra, account lead @emma-sales. If you escalate, follow the runbook escalation section. I'll check in 01:30 UTC and hand over fully at 09:00 UTC.

jonathan: :thumbsup: Good handoff. I'll monitor from 01:30 and post status updates every 30m in this thread.

oncall-bot: Subscribed thread to incident feed for 8 hours.
